bioNe: सामाजिक अभियन्ता, अनुसन्धानकर्ता र युवा नेतृका रूपमा पहिचान बनाएकी यजस्वी राई युथ कांग्रेस नेपालकी केन्द्रीय सभापति हुन्। उनी नेपाली कांग्रेसको १५औँ महाधिवेशनका लागि काठमाडौं क्षेत्र नं. १ बाट महाधिवेशन प्रतिनिधिमा निर्विरोध चयन भएकी छन्।

सिड्नी विश्वविद्यालयबाट दिगोपनामा स्नातकोत्तर र काठमाडौं विश्वविद्यालयबाट डेभलपमेन्ट स्टडीजमा स्नातक गरेकी राई अष्ट्रेलिया अवार्डकी प्राप्तकर्ता हुन्। उनले शासन, सामाजिक जवाफदेहिता, लैंगिक समानता, दिगो विकास र युवा सहभागिताका क्षेत्रमा राष्ट्रिय तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संस्थासँग काम गरेकी छन्।
bioEn: Yajaswi spent her childhood in Kathmandu with her extended family. After graduating from Kathmandu University with a Bachelor's in Development Studies, she founded Leklekk, which means “green” in Rai, her mother tongue. The company brought circular-economy practices to the education and hospitality sectors.

To take that work further, she won an Australia Award. After a two-year delay caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, she began her Master of Sustainability at the University of Sydney in 2022 and graduated with Distinction.

She returned to Nepal in January 2024 and has since shared sustainability tools, frameworks and ideas in forums across the country, working to bring the social, economic and environmental sides of development together. She lectured on governance and social accountability at National College, Kathmandu University, and has researched climate change, foreign employment and AI ethics to produce policy briefs for Nepal's parliamentarians.

Since 2024 she has led Youth Congress Nepal. She was elected unopposed as a Kathmandu-1 delegate to the Nepali Congress 15th General Convention, and is now a candidate for Central Member from Bagmati Province in the young women (under 35) cluster.
quote: If I can contribute to the betterment of our country, why wouldn't I? When you leave and don't return, the country loses one more beacon of hope for improvement.

points: Leading the organisation and bringing young people into public debate and democratic processes.
Designed and delivered courses on governance, social accountability and policy, including case studies on ethical technology in developing economies.
Mentored students' research projects on societal impact and policy implications.
Researched climate change, foreign employment and AI ethics to produce policy briefs for parliamentarians of Nepal.
Led climate-resilient agriculture training for women leaders and practitioners in Bagmati, Sudurpaschim and Karnali Provinces with Finn Church Aid.
Designing an Integrated Sustainability Assessment Toolkit for Jitpur Simara Sub-Metropolitan City, Bara.

Ran GEDSI audits (including for WOREC), coordinated a Feminist Foreign Policy project for CESIF with Australian Embassy support, and evaluated projects for ActionAid Nepal, ActionAid Arab Region and the Dignity Initiative.
Led participatory consultations in Sudurpaschim and Madhesh on the social and political space of women and marginalised communities.
Co-designed Anupam Abhiyan, a four-year nationwide movement for women's rights in public spaces.
Produced ten videos on leadership, gender equality, inclusion, SRHR and intersectionality for children and youth in four rural districts.
Advocated, with the team, for the first separate budget allocations for sexual and gender minorities in four provinces.
Launched AbaNormal, a social media series on underrated issues of gender and current affairs.
Co-designed EmpowHER, a leadership and entrepreneurship institute for girls and women aged 12–29.
Initiated the March Movement, bringing together 31 well-known Nepalis to make resolutions for a gender-just world.
A circular-economy enterprise promoting sustainability in education and hospitality.

honours: Australia Awards Recipient 2022, and Face of Australia Awards 2023
Winner, Youth Enterprise and Social Innovation Challenge 2021
Winner, UN Plural+ Youth Video Festival, for the LGBTIQ+ rights documentary Pahichan (2021)
First runner-up, Summit Woman of the Year 2020
Speaker, Asia Pacific Regional AI Conference 2023; Scholars Forum, Canberra 2023; Reykjavik Global Forum 2021
Executive Member, Global Youth Biodiversity Network – Nepal Chapter, 2020 – 2021
Contributing Writer, AI and Human Rights Investor Toolkit (Responsible Investment Association Australasia), 2024
